name: Secure API & Integration Suite
summary: Secure application APIs connected to external services.
description: Development and maintenance of authenticated REST APIs and third-party integrations. The work includes payment, mailing, and address verification services alongside OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT authentication.
technologies: ASP.NET Core, .NET 8 / .NET 9, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, REST APIs, OpenAPI
challenge: External services have different authentication models and response contracts, while application APIs need a consistent security boundary.
approach: Use authenticated API endpoints with clear request and response contracts, implement the required third-party integrations, and document the interfaces through OpenAPI.
